text:
alexa: Quick sync — final checklist for the webinar landing launch. Need owners for redirects, schema, KW mapping, internal linking, and UTM plan. Can we get owners and a short note on blockers? :calendar: 

mike: I can own keyword mapping + canonical strategy. Will produce a prioritized KW table (primary, secondary, longtail) and target headings by Tue.

jamie: I’ll own page copy + meta titles/descriptions, and a content-level internal linking map to core product pages. Need the KW table from mike to finalize CTAs.

leo: Dev can implement redirects and anchor link structure. Heads up — if we change the slug across languages we’ll need 301s + a small server-side mapping. I’ll need the final slug list by Wed morning.

sara: I’ll take schema and structured data (FAQ + Event schema). Quick note: if we use dynamic times, Event schema must include startDate in ISO and stable URL. Also recommend adding Organization + Logo markup to improve rich results.

ben: I’ll own UTM and analytics tagging. Suggest canonical UTMs for webinar email, blog post, and paid promos. Will provide tracking table and GA4 event names.

alexa: Great — so owners: keywords/mapping = mike; copy/linking = jamie; redirects = leo; schema = sara; utm/analytics = ben. Two quick gotchas: 1) canonicalization if we serve the page under both /webinars/x and /resources/x — mike pls confirm canonical. 2) Internal link depth: avoid >3 clicks to trial flow.

mike: Confirmed: canonical should point to /webinars/x (primary). If we keep /resources/x we make it a 301 to /webinars/x and add rel=canonical on the page as extra safety. I’ll include canonical snippet in the KW doc.

leo: Redirect snippet I’ll push in the RFC. Example for nginx: ```
location = /resources/webinar-old {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.com/webinars/new-webinar;
}
```
Also adding a short redirect map CSV helps automation.

sara: Schema checklist draft: [ ] Event schema (startDate, endDate, url) [ ] FAQPage (Q/A pairs matching page) [ ] BreadcrumbList [ ] Organization (logo + sameAs) [ ] Social meta (og:title, og:description, twitter card). Will put sample JSON-LD in the doc.

jamie: Internal linking plan: hero CTA -> signup, mid-article contextual links to product pages with anchor text (use KW variations mike provides), footer link to resources hub. I’ll avoid linking to blog list pages that dilute authority.

ben: UTM plan: email = utm_source=email&utm_medium=crm&utm_campaign=webinar_may; blog teaser = source=blog; paid = source=paid_search. Will add campaign taxonomy and GA4 event names to the tracking sheet.

alexa: Blockers: international slugs (i18n) and canonical for mirrored pages. leo + mike to sync on i18n canonical strategy before Wed. jamie needs final KW by Tue EOD to lock meta. sara will hand over JSON-LD samples by Wed AM. ben to share UTM table Tue PM.

jamie: Action items summary: [mike] KW table + canonical recommendation (due Tue EOD) | [leo] redirect CSV + nginx rules (due Wed AM) | [sara] JSON-LD schema samples + FAQ questions (due Wed AM) | [ben] UTM + GA4 event sheet (due Tue PM) | [alexa] confirm promotional channels and send content brief (today).

alexa: Thanks all — please drop updates in this thread when done. :thumbsup:
